NEVER discharge it with a device that makes the file compile without actually proving the statement: no new `axiom`, no `admit`, no unproven auxiliary `axiom`/lemma cited by `exact`, no `decide` on a claim that is not genuinely decidable, no `@[implemented_by]`/`@[extern]` or `sorry` hidden inside a helper. - If a declaration is genuinely beyond you this turn, LEAVE its `sorry` exactly as it is (do not replace it with a fake discharge) and report honestly that you could not prove it, naming the decl and the concrete blocker (missing lemma, unclear step, integrability side-condition, etc.). - The only CausalSmith imports you may add or retain are same-run modules under `CausalSmith.Substrate.MartingaleArrayClt.*`. Paper/research modules and helpers from other runs are forbidden dependencies. If such a dependency is needed, leave the blocker and report it instead of copying the definition.

blocker. Run the actual targeted build (`lake build <edited modules>` from the `CausalSmith`

other edited module must still build cleanly.

Use the lean-lsp MCP tools to develop/check your proof (diagnostics/goal). When done, output a
